description: Get one use case from Ergin's library by its slug (from find_use_cases, or the last part of its ergini.com/use-cases URL): the summary, what the AI does and what people still do, every system it touches, the service it is built as, its typical price tier from the published price table, and related use cases. A hub slug (such as 'finance' or 'shopify') returns the hub and its use cases instead.

slug.description: The use case or hub slug, e.g. 'invoice-processing-automation', or its full URL.

name: get_use_case
title: Get one use case
